meta.title: Daniel Oliver Racing | Racing Driver × Software Engineer

hero.imageAlt: Daniel Oliver standing at the pit wall in his race suit, helmet under his arm
hero.intro: Every lap is a dataset. Every mistake, an experiment. From the simulator to an FIA international licence in six months, and in 2026, the IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge.

about.paragraph1: Daniel Oliver didn't inherit racing. He engineered his way into it. From a sim rig and a software career to an FIA international licence in around six months, with multiple wins along the way.
about.paragraph2: Today he races a Praga prototype in the UK, and in 2026 he makes his IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge debut, bringing an engineer's discipline to every stint.
about.imageAlt: Daniel Oliver fastening his helmet before a session

simReal.intro: "Every lap is a dataset, every mistake an experiment." The engineering mindset isn't a gimmick, it's the whole operating system.

cards.title: Measure
cards.body: Telemetry over feel. Braking points, throttle traces, minimum speeds: the data decides where the lap time lives.

cards.title: Simulate
cards.body: Hypotheses get tested in the sim first, where experiments are cheap and repeatable, then validated on track.

cards.title: Execute
cards.body: Consistency on demand. Not one hero lap, but the same correct lap, every lap, when it counts.
